crossRefs.note: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

translations.web: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.
translations.bsb: If a man wishes to redeem part of his tithe, he must add a fifth to its value.
translations.kjv: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth
translations.asv: And if a man will redeem aught of his tithe, he shall add unto it the fifth part thereof.
